Although the trimmed‑mean candidates are more stable, their higher scores suggest they are not capturing the trend as effectively. loop.top3_why_not: Candidate B and C use trimmed‑mean over larger pools, which introduces more variance in the weighting and yields higher validation errors.  Their per‑window performance is consistently worse than the median, and the added complexity does not justify the marginal gain in stability.  Therefore they are less suitable for this series.
